## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set contains only Benign [F1], but all five similar cases are Normal on this stain-degraded frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, Normal 4%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) | Strong Benign call; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% alpha (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability (AUROC 70%), 8th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical embedding despite severity-3 stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign; 5/5 Normal (94%–96% similarity) [F5] | Nearest references all labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.52 contribution) opposes invasive; 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.58 contribution) opposes invasive; 18/20 check, caption inconsistent [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.29 contribution) nudges toward invasive; 12/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.25 contribution) opposes invasive; 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful across test set (top-3 deletion drop vs random +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, excludes 0; n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); top driver normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- All 5 nearest reference cases are Normal (94%–96% similarity), and severity-3 stain degradation distorts frozen-section morphology (cell segmentation disabled).
- Medial margin segment reaches 97% probability (superior 48%), just below the 0.9998 threshold despite the clear call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: Inspect medial (97%) and superior (48%) margin segments plus top stromal invasion score (0.69).
2. **Regions 1, 3, 4, 9, 11**: Verify benign tubule formation (3, 9, 11) versus normal lobules (1, 4, 11).
3. **Regions 2, 8, 10**: Review ductal atypia (region 8), lymphocytes (region 2), and pleomorphism (region 10; risk 0.001).
